The raw NAF files were used only to verify that each operational graph matches one Wikinews article and that those files contain no manual annotation layers. They are not included. Checksums of those 30 files are in `../WIKINEWS/raw_naf_checksums.tsv`.

Operational TextGraphs were produced from the Wikinews articles. `document_manifest.tsv` records source title, source URL, publication date, attribution, licence, and transformation description. `meantime_metadata_used=yes` and `contains_meantime_annotation=no` for every operational graph in this study. See `inputs/operational/SOURCE_NOTICE.md`.
